shared_guard: actual view.storeIdentity equals context.storeIdentity. Select exactly one current upload request by UTF8-exact operation/target/registration and immutable start identity. Reject canonically equivalent but byte-distinct aliases, including ambiguous original logical rows.

The compact selection is not proof: join exactly one actual StoredUploadMetadataObservation via matches(saved), real observe key/fingerprint/receipt and isCommitted. Join its full CommittedUploadMetadataQuery and actual current DeviceRegistration (intent+commit included) from view; expected UUID must be current.

Require query.kind lookup(session), response.status(receiving), full ten-field binding and chunkSize/session equal range.binding, exact original/operation/registration, selected index absent. created POST/finalizing/completed/failed/cancelled cannot start a chunk.

Selected query is latest by all reservations for that operation; selected generation equals request.lastObservation, no uploadMetadataPending or uploadMetadataHold. Pending newer query shadows an older receiving response even when old hasReconciled was true.

Before attempt: request.canRun, no active/stopRequested/current owner or same-operation orphan original reader, no reused task/attempt/source ID. Strict/capture/removal process admission remains App responsibility before any begin/lease/copy/factory.

Current attempt: exact request.attempt/context, transport active, running intent, empty waits, no ended/completed/cancelled; original saved binding/current reg/no removal/invalidation/removed; exact new lease is current reader. No other same-operation reader/source may remain. Original lease epoch and store media reconciliation epoch remain separate axes.
For current attempt, exclude only the exact same already-prepared intent when validating resumeRequested. An arbitrary equal task ID or altered payload may not hide an older owner.

Every prior task for this operation must be accounted for, never only max/last. Require unique task/attempt/source IDs, exact original/reg/session/binding/source and actual terminal then ownerClosed. Refuse unbound prepared/create-attach gaps, unclosed/unknown sources, orphan leases and any mixed whole/chunk history in the minimal multi-attempt branch.

For each prior chunk find exactly matching real requestTransition.stopped receipt in prefix, after its ownerClosed; require selected GET observation commit strictly after every prior stopped. Require selected GET commit strictly before the exact current beginAttempt commit, which is before prepared/resumeRequested. No arrival timestamps or current mutable transport substitute for this sequence.

snapshot_vs_projection.app_pre_attempt: Load backend snapshot B1, original state O, and loadRemovalTransportInventory(original). Require B1.revision==O.revision/current UUID, exact inventory.matchesProjection(B1), and no conflicting operation-owned readers. Confirm referenced journal mutations through exact lookup; reload B2 and O2 and require same revision/UUID/identity/current registration/request/selection and exact original reader state before returning a preliminary success. A changed revision causes a fresh read-only evaluation, not rebasing unknown mutation.
snapshot_vs_projection.same_writer: Document uses its current/historical projection and actual prefixes only. The current prepared/resumeRequested event cannot use future stop/query/release facts. It additionally checks actual originalJournal.release(exact lease) after ownerClosed and before matching stopped. App preliminary view cannot establish that original-release ordering from transport inventory alone; writer is final authority.
snapshot_vs_projection.races: App reads are advisory: pause/cancel, new GET, registration rotation, removal, newer attempt or store identity change between awaits or copy and prepared is refused by final writer. Existing unknown mutation remains its original expectedRevision/payload lookup-only.
snapshot_vs_projection.live_vs_replay: No live file/recording/hash/network read is introduced into replay. Current lease/binding/reg at each historical event comes from ordered journal projection. Real native/source/file checks remain App/Native ownership.

multi_chunk_stop_history.existing_limitation: OriginalRemovalTransportHistory.stoppedTasks currently requires matches.count==1 and compares all task attempt values to request.current attempt. This cannot represent serial chunk attempts.
multi_chunk_stop_history.minimal_new_branch: Retain the whole-upload single-task branch byte/behavior semantics. Add a pure all-uploadChunk branch which emits one TransportStopReceipt per exact historical task/attempt, in stable backgroundTasks preparation order; current request must be stopped with attempt equal the last task, prior attempts are matched to their own contexts/journal, not current attempt. Download or mixed whole/chunk remains unknown.
multi_chunk_stop_history.fence: Keep stops.count==tasks.count and existing fence per-task actual stopped-after-ownerClosed journal checks; duplicates/foreign/unmatched receipts refuse. Each historical terminal/closure event and actual stopped mutation must be exact-confirmed by the sealed producer; final fresh SDK enumeration, exact inventory and every lease absence remain required.
multi_chunk_stop_history.scope: stoppedTasks is a presentation/candidate predicate, not all-media quiescence or deletion permission. Chunk SDK completed is not whole request completed; record stopped + hasReconciled=false until a new GET. No external result/verification/finalize/ACK/Photos/deletion is generated.
multi_chunk_stop_history.app_followups: Coordinator invalidation/person/capture/removal/history loops must use uploadOwnership and handle older closed chunk attempts by historical own context; do not retain whole-only request.attempt==oldTask.attempt guard for the history branch, or weaken current live-task guard. No SDK/source adoption after reopen.
